research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Palitronica is researching systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of processors and local networks, as described in titles such as 'Systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of a processor connected to a communication network' and 'Systems and methods for side-channel monitoring of a local network.' Their work includes non-intrusive program tracing using power consumption, electromagnetic emission, and acoustic emanation to monitor device and control processor activity. These efforts focus on cyber-protection for critical infrastructure.

product.description: A hardware and software solution for non-destructive, rapid testing of electronic components to detect defects, counterfeit parts, and hardware implants in supply chains.

product.name: PowerFuzzer
product.description: A software validation tool that uses side-channel analysis to verify firmware integrity and detect unauthorized changes or vulnerabilities in electronic devices.
